description: This file defines a template interface IIteratorType within the WPEFramework::RPC namespace. The interface provides methods for iterator functionality over elements, including traversal, reset, validation, count, and retrieving the current element.

classes.name: IIteratorType
classes.description: A template interface for iterators over elements, with methods to navigate and access elements in a collection.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element, outputs the element via reference. Returns true if successful.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous element, outputs the element via reference. Returns true if successful.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to a specified position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current position of the iterator is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current element the iterator points to.
